propositions: Rich-text encoding differs between Cloud (ADF JSON) and Data Center (wiki/plain text); today ADF logic is hardwired into the Cloud path causing duplication when DC adapters need the same mapper

A RichTextCodec Protocol with four operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must replace hardcoded ADF calls so each caller can compose operations distinctly without changing observable behavior
Two existing Cloud call paths use different combinations of fit and normalize steps; collapsing them into one operation would break pinned behavior, so all four operations must remain separate
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/ and WikiTextCodec in adapters/jira_family/, with no cross-import, to enforce the existing vendor-separation constraint verified by J2's import-contract test

map_fields_to_remote must have exactly one real implementation (in adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py), with Cloud and DC backends delegating or injecting the codec, eliminating the duplication from PR #120
